result.instructions: Tools for TreePlotter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which trees in our INVENTORY folder are in poor condition?"; "List all work orders that are still open."; "Show the field names for the trees layer before we add a new tree.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TreePlotter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run treeplotter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run treeplotter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run treeplotter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. treeplotter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: treeplotter_list_inventories
tools.title: List inventory layers
tools.description: List the inventory layers in this TreePlotter folder (for example trees), with alias and geometry type. Good first call. GET /<folder>/inventories.

tools.name: treeplotter_get_inventory_metadata
tools.title: Get inventory field metadata
tools.description: Get the fields, field types and lookup tables of one inventory layer. Use it to read field names before you create or update features. GET /<folder>/metadata/inventories/<inventory>.

inventory.description: Inventory layer name, from treeplotter_list_inventories (for example trees).

tools.name: treeplotter_list_features
tools.title: List features in a layer
tools.description: List GeoJSON features (assets) of one inventory layer, one page at a time. Use offset to get the next page. GET /<folder>/inventories/<inventory>.

inventory.description: Inventory layer name, from treeplotter_list_inventories (for example trees).

dateFilterField.description: Internal field name for date filtering (for example last_modified).

dateFilterGTEMillis.description: Only features with dateFilterField at or after this time (ms).

dateFilterLTMillis.description: Only features with dateFilterField before this time (ms).

tools.name: treeplotter_list_translated_features
tools.title: List features with readable values
tools.description: List features of one inventory layer with lookup values translated to readable text. Read-only. GET /<folder>/translated/inventories/<inventory>.

inventory.description: Inventory layer name, from treeplotter_list_inventories (for example trees).

dateFilterField.description: Internal field name for date filtering (for example last_modified).

tools.name: treeplotter_get_feature
tools.title: Get a feature
tools.description: Get one feature (asset) of an inventory layer by its Primary ID. GET /<folder>/inventories/<inventory>/<pid>.

inventory.description: Inventory layer name, from treeplotter_list_inventories (for example trees).

pid.description: Primary ID (pid) of the item, from a list tool.

tools.name: treeplotter_list_work_activities
tools.title: List work activities
tools.description: List the work activity types (for example Prune Tree) that work records can use. GET /<folder>/wom/workactivities.

tools.name: treeplotter_list_work_fields
tools.title: List work record fields
tools.description: List the fields that work records can use, with their layer names. GET /<folder>/wom/workfields.

tools.name: treeplotter_list_work_records
tools.title: List work records
tools.description: List work records (work done on assets). GET /<folder>/wom/workrecords.

tools.name: treeplotter_list_service_requests
tools.title: List service requests
tools.description: List service requests (citizen or customer requests about assets). GET /<folder>/wom/servicerequests.

tools.name: treeplotter_get_service_request
tools.title: Get a service request
tools.description: Get one service request by its ID. GET /<folder>/wom/servicerequests/<pid>.

pid.description: Primary ID (pid) of the item, from a list tool.

tools.name: treeplotter_get_job
tools.title: Get a work order (job)
tools.description: Get one work order (job) by its ID. GET /<folder>/wom/jobs/<pid>.

pid.description: Primary ID (pid) of the item, from a list tool.

tools.name: treeplotter_get_jobs_metadata
tools.title: Get work order metadata
tools.description: Get the field metadata for work orders (jobs). GET /<folder>/wom/jobs/metadata.

tools.name: treeplotter_create_feature
tools.title: Create a feature
tools.description: Create a new feature (asset) in an inventory layer. Point layers need lat and lng in data. Check field names with treeplotter_get_inventory_metadata first. POST /<folder>/inventories/<inventory>.

inventory.description: Inventory layer name, from treeplotter_list_inventories (for example trees).

data.description: Field values as an object. Field names come from treeplotter_get_inventory_metadata.

tools.name: treeplotter_update_feature
tools.title: Update a feature
tools.description: Update fields of one feature (asset) by its Primary ID. Only the fields you send change. PUT /<folder>/inventories/<inventory>/<pid>.

inventory.description: Inventory layer name, from treeplotter_list_inventories (for example trees).

pid.description: Primary ID (pid) of the item, from a list tool.

data.description: Field values as an object. Field names come from treeplotter_get_inventory_metadata.

tools.name: treeplotter_create_job
tools.title: Create a work order (job)
tools.description: Create a new work order (job). Check field names with treeplotter_get_jobs_metadata first. POST /<folder>/wom/jobs.

data.description: Field values as an object. Field names come from treeplotter_get_inventory_metadata.

tools.name: treeplotter_update_job
tools.title: Update a work order (job)
tools.description: Update fields of one work order (job) by its ID, for example its status. Only the fields you send change. PUT /<folder>/wom/jobs/<pid>.

pid.description: Primary ID (pid) of the item, from a list tool.

data.description: Field values as an object. Field names come from treeplotter_get_inventory_metadata.
